name: 2captcha-mcp
description: Web scraping with anti-bot bypass, marketplace parsing to structured JSON, browser automation and CAPTCHA solving for AI agents
long_description: The official 2Captcha Model Context Protocol (MCP) server gives LLMs and AI agents real-time access to web data behind anti-bot protection. Scrape any page through a tiered ladder (hidden JSON APIs, TLS-impersonating HTTP, rotating residential proxies, managed browser with CAPTCHA solving), parse marketplace product and search pages into clean structured JSON, extract arbitrary JSON-schema data from any URL, drive a real browser step by step, and solve any CAPTCHA type 2Captcha supports.

tools.name: scrape_page
tools.description: Fetch any URL and return its readable content as markdown (or raw HTML), defeating anti-bot protection with a tiered ladder: fast HTTP, TLS impersonation, rotating residential proxies, managed browser with CAPTCHA solving. No LLM cost.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Find URLs for a query: ranked organic results with title, url and snippet.

tools.name: discover_urls
tools.description: List URLs a site publishes in robots.txt and XML sitemaps, without crawling pages — a reviewable URL inventory for the batch tools.

tools.name: parse_marketplace
tools.description: Parse a marketplace product page or search listing into structured JSON (title, price, rating, seller, stock, …), taking the cheapest tier that works: hidden JSON API, JSON-LD, learned selectors, then LLM extraction.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract data matching your own JSON Schema from any URL or from raw text you already hold, via LLM extraction (BYOK-aware).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Identity and capability probe: tenant, configured providers, spend counters. No network, no cost.

tools.name: scrape_pages
tools.description: Batch scrape_page over many URLs as a background job; returns a job you can poll.

tools.name: parse_pages
tools.description: Batch parse_marketplace over many URLs as a background job; returns a job you can poll.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a batch job: status, per-item results as they complete.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running batch job (stops further spend).

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the managed browser session to a URL; reports blocked status.

tools.name: browser_go_back
tools.description: Go back in the browser session history.

tools.name: browser_go_forward
tools.description: Go forward in the browser session history.

tools.name: browser_reload
tools.description: Reload the current page.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or an element.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element by snapshot ref or CSS selector.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an element key by key.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Fill an input with a value.

tools.name: browser_select_option
tools.description: Select an option in a dropdown.

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag one element onto another.

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key in the page.

tools.name: browser_get_text
tools.description: Get the visible text of the page or of matching elements.

tools.name: browser_get_html
tools.description: Get the HTML of the page or of matching elements.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Read the page's console output.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page and return the result.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility-tree snapshot of the page with element refs for the interaction tools.

tools.name: browser_snapshot_items
tools.description: Compact list of interactive elements with refs.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the current page (PNG).

tools.name: browser_save_as_pdf
tools.description: Save the current page as PDF.

tools.name: browser_save_session
tools.description: Persist the current login state (cookies, storage) under a name.

tools.name: browser_load_session
tools.description: Restore a previously saved login state.

tools.name: browser_list_sessions
tools.description: List saved login states.

tools.name: list_captcha_types
tools.description: The catalogue of solvable CAPTCHA types with their required parameters — call before solve_captcha.

tools.name: solve_captcha
tools.description: Solve a CAPTCHA of any supported type (reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, hCaptcha, image, …) and return the token/answer.

tools.name: captcha_report
tools.description: Report a solution as good or bad (a bad report refunds).

tools.name: captcha_balance
tools.description: Current 2Captcha balance in USD.

tools.name: session_stats
tools.description: Tool usage during this session.

groups.title: Tool groups
groups.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable: parsing, batch, browser, captcha, all (default: parsing,batch,captcha)
